title: The rain gauge, full
logline: The rain gauge on the doorframe full and overflowing, January 2023, the pup looking at it. The page's second measurement. The number still not lettered.

panels.composition: A plastic rain gauge nailed to a garage doorframe full and overflowing, a small three-legged dog looking up at it, rain.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a plastic rain gauge nailed to a garage doorframe full and overflowing in rain with a small three-legged dog looking up at it, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
